records.question: Combine the corpus description with Table 1: what train/dev/test split was used, and which configuration achieved the best F-score?
records.answer:
The corpus was split into 80% training, 10% development, and 10% test episodes.
The split contained 35,865 training utterances, 3,904 development utterances, and 3,903 test utterances.
Table 1 shows the best F-score was 62.9%, achieved by LSTM + high level features.
The LSTM with the high level feature vector achieved the highest accuracy of 70.0% and the highest F-score of 62.9%.

| Classifier and features         |   Accuracy |   Precision |   Recall |   F-score |
